hooks.name: Verify Spec & Protocol Alignment
hooks.description: When the tether-protocol spec changes, asks the agent to reconcile the TypeScript protocol, codec validators and property tests with it.

action.prompt: The tether-protocol spec was just updated. Compare it with tetherkit-core/src/protocol/types.ts, tetherkit-core/src/protocol/codec.ts and tetherkit-core/src/transport/signal-types.ts. Update types and decodeMessage validators for any added or changed message fields, add or adjust the matching fast-check property in tetherkit-core/tests, keep the Correctness Properties table in design.md in sync, then run `pnpm test:pbt` and `pnpm typecheck` and report the result.
